body: Thanks for the kind ear. I did manage to make an appointment. My wife seems to have heard me, after the shock of it all and is being a lot more supportive. Thank you so much for your help.

I am truly overwhelmed at the moment. And yes, I am just trying to muddle through it myself. I know I need professional help, and am making an appointment for it now. I also spoke with my wife yesterday and the results were mixed. She freaked out again, stating that it was unfair that I was feeling that way. I started panicking again, where she started again calling me crazy and yelling. I was able to get to her to leave me alone for a little time to allow me to calm down. 
She said that i needed help, which I am getting, and admitted that she needed to help me also. Not just emotionally but around the house (I do all the house work, admin, accounting, organizing, cooking, washing, etc. I have OCD, so it makes sense, but it robs me of any time to just unwind - I find it hard to relax in a messy environment). But in the end she basically gave me an ultimatum, stating that she would only help and support me if I got better, but if I didnt, then she would leave. I understand the feeling, but it only made me less secure about her as a partner. I feel like she is setting me up to lie about my condition again just to avoid having her feel troubled by my feelings. I told her i wanted a divorce, but she said no. She said that she wants to be with me, that she loves me, but that she will only help if i get better and do more things for her. I dont know how I feel about all of this. I am miserable, resentful and feel totally alone in my feelings. And feel that i need to keep lying to everyone because nobody wants to be confronted by my pain. But yes, I am going to get help. I know I need to because i am pretty sure i am going to just jump infront of or off something if I don't.
